a.lede: Nintendo's Switch 2 sales decreased by 41% compared to the same time frame last year due to an increase in the console's price. Investors are pressuring Nintendo to release more big games to attract more Switch 2 buyers.
a.title: Nintendo Switch 2 sales dropped by 41% from last year due to console's price increase

b.lede: Despite market conditions making PS5 consoles expensive and hard to get, Sony's gaming division had a solid quarter.
b.title: Sony is selling more PS5 games but still struggling to meet console demand
